findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - An operator sets a positive `FORGE_CHECKS_WAIT` while one test group is running and another is queued for a runner.
The pre-push loop resets the deadline on every poll whenever any check is queued, even if the running and queued checks make no progress. Close and land can therefore wait through the entire runner queue instead of honoring the requested running-check limit. The new override test uses only `0`, which bypasses this deadline reset.
findings.title: Honor the wait override before pushing the review record

why: Issues 1666 and 1639: with long runner queues (57 to 118 minutes measured at a client), close and merge end their wait and print 'Next: forge close', so the coordinator restarts them many times, and time a job spends queued for a runner counts against the 60-minute test limit, so jobs that only waited are cancelled
